name: Hanging L-Sit Pull-Up
description: A pull-up performed while maintaining an L-sit position with legs parallel to the floor. This requires the hip flexors and core to maintain the L-sit while the back and biceps perform the pull-up. The combined demand makes this one of the most challenging bodyweight pulling movements.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Hanging L-Sit Pull-Up in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Hanging L-Sit Pull-Up.
steps: Step 1: Hang from bar and raise legs to horizontal L-sit position.
Step 2: Maintaining leg position, pull up until chin clears bar.
Step 3: Lower with control while keeping legs horizontal.
Step 4: Complete all reps without letting legs drop.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Letting legs drop during the pull
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Master L-sit and strict pull-up separately first
